column3: Being built up and multiplied is rendered as growing in strength and numbers.
“The area” supplies the scope of passing through all; “visit” specifies the descent to the saints.
“Put away your mat” replaces the instruction to make or spread his bed for himself; “Aeneas” supplies the subject at the end.
Being full of good works is rendered as always being occupied with them.
The unnamed people washing and placing her are recast as passive actions on her body.
“Still” is supplied in the clause about Dorcas being with them.
“Of the room” specifies the direction out.
“Peter” supplies the subject; giving her a hand becomes taking her by the hand.
